description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: check an x402 endpoint before paying it. Will a default x402 client be able to pay? Validates accepts[] completeness (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), placeholder scan of the published input example, challenge size vs the 8190 B edge limit. Input: url = absolute http(s) URL. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix each. Use before listing an API, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
